constraints.text: Do not add spoken or sung lines.

claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
The car's headlights cast two bright cones that progressively reveal a narrow strip of ground ahead.
The surrounding space is an unbroken black void with no visible horizon, props, or other vehicles.
The car has a low, dark body with light-catching front surfaces and a solid silhouette.
A low engine note rises from near silence and deepens as the car accelerates.

subjects.description: The car specified by the request: a low, dark vehicle whose body is initially almost indistinguishable from the surrounding black and whose headlights become the main source of illumination as it advances.
The near-total darkness around and ahead of the car, with no visible horizon or background detail until the headlights reach the ground.

description.text: sits facing the lens, its low body almost indistinguishable from the black around it. Only a faint edge of roof and hood separates the shape from the void; the

presses close on every side, with no horizon or background detail visible. The car is motionless at first, then begins to roll forward. Its headlights thicken into two bright cones that push the shadow back from the ground immediately ahead, revealing a narrow strip of textured surface and the first sense of distance between the vehicle and the space it is leaving. The movement is steady and deliberate, the car growing slightly more legible as light reaches its front surfaces while the surrounding black remains otherwise unbroken. The beams do not yet reach far; they carve a small, advancing pocket of visibility out of the dark, and the car's forward line stays fixed as it starts to come clear.
remains a still, barely separable silhouette facing the lens.
A low engine note rises from near silence, soft and steady under the dark.
begins to roll forward; its headlights thicken into two cones and push the shadow back from the ground ahead.

continues pulling forward, its body and forward surfaces catching more of the light as it leaves the deepest shadow behind. The twin headlight beams now stretch farther across the ground, exposing a widening path of rough, pale-edged surface while the car gathers pace toward the lens side of frame. Its silhouette becomes fully readable: a dark, solid form with bright lamps leading the advance, the contrast between lit metal and surrounding black sharpening with each meter. The engine tone deepens as the car accelerates, and the last pockets of shadow slide away from the front of the vehicle. The car closes distance without turning, holding its forward line as the illuminated ground and the car's own moving shape dominate the frame. Light spills across the front corners and along the lower body, but the background remains a clean, unbroken black beyond the reach of the lamps.

The engine tone deepens as the car accelerates, remaining low and continuous.

soundscape: A low engine note rises from near silence, then deepens into a steady mechanical tone as the car accelerates. No dialogue, voices, or added music.
